text: たたかうポケモンが　いなくなります！

patterns.name: 〜なくなる
patterns.explanation: A 'not' form changed to なく plus なる means it gets to the point of not being so. いなくなります = 'there will no longer be any'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right before a thing describes that thing. たたかうポケモン = 'Pokémon that fight'.
